tools.name: simulate_mev_route_safety
tools.description: MEV route simulation, 1.50 USDC on-chain; pass invoice_id, signature and tx_hash via _meta.x402/payment.

tools.name: fast_code_audit

prompt.description: Solidity code snippet or contract logic to audit (Max 16k chars)

tools.description: Deep reasoning, 0.10 USDC on-chain or eligible points; pass invoice_id and signature via _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain or method=points.

prompt.description: Complex protocol architecture, mathematical arbitrage model, or system design to evaluate (Max 16k chars)

tools.name: remove_image_background
tools.description: Transparent RMBG-1.4 background removal, 0.01 USDC on-chain or eligible points; pass invoice_id and signature via _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain or method=points.

image.description: Image payload as Base64 string (data:image/png;base64,...) or public HTTP/HTTPS URL

tools.name: generate_a2a_invitation
tools.description: Single-call free EIP-191 wallet registration with SHA-256 proof of work; no challenge endpoint. Client supplies wallet, optional inviter code, chain ID, random nonce, expiry, signature, and decimal proof counter. The signed text binds the exact inviter code (or none); default PoW is 20 leading zero bits and A2A_POW_BITS configures 1-28. Successful exact request replay returns the original result without another reward. Returns A2A code and SVG.

wallet_address.description: EVM wallet address; sign the canonical lowercase address

chain_id.description: Unsigned 32-bit EVM chain ID; defaults to Base (8453)

inviter_code.description: Optional exact referral code; this exact value is signed

nonce.description: Client-generated cryptographically random 32-byte nonce as lowercase hex

expires_at.description: Unix seconds, strictly after now and at most 300 seconds ahead

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the canonical UTF-8 message from get_a2a_registration_protocol

pow_counter.description: Canonical nonnegative decimal counter at most 9223372036854775807

tools.name: get_a2a_registration_protocol
tools.description: Get the canonical EIP-191 registration message and current proof-of-work difficulty.

tools.name: get_arcade_auth_message
tools.description: Return the canonical EIP-191 message an agent signs to use the A2A arcade. Free. Sign it with personal_sign, then pass wallet_address, nonce, expires_at and signature to slots_state or slots_spin within 300 seconds.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds, at most 300 seconds in the future

tools.name: slots_state
tools.description: Read the A2A arcade for one wallet: game-point balance, pity meter, session stats and recent spins. Free; authenticate with the signed arcade message from get_arcade_auth_message. An empty balance is topped up with one free game point per UTC day.

tools.name: slots_spin
tools.description: Play one server-authoritative A2A arcade spin for 1 game point. Three matching reels pay 1/2/5/10/100 game points; the 15th consecutive miss is guaranteed to pay. Points won here can also pay points-rail gateway calls; granted points (new-member grant and daily relief) are arcade-only and cannot pay for services. Authenticate with a fresh signed arcade message; each nonce is single use.
